description: This Java source file defines an Akka actor class 'PolicyEventForwarder' that acts as a cluster singleton. Its main role is to listen for policy events, forward them to an updater actor, and maintain policy revision states with streaming logic and namespace management. The class handles subscription to distributed pub/sub, streams policy revision dumps periodically, and manages stream lifecycle.

classes.name: PolicyEventForwarder
classes.description: An Akka actor class that manages policy event forwarding and revision state stream, intended as a cluster singleton in distributed environments.
